about: The most used JavaScript library for interactive maps.

prs.title: Fitting a map with very large padding no longer zooms all the way in
prs.broken: If the padding given to fitBounds was bigger than the map, the map jumped to its closest zoom instead of the widest one.
prs.changed: When there is no room left after the padding, Leaflet now returns the widest zoom allowed.
prs.matters: A sidebar on a phone-width map, or a map in a hidden tab, no longer lands on a useless street-level view.
